app.scheduling.help_published: Every cell paints three layers: the base the shift pattern projects (muted, dashed), a roster override (solid, corner mark) and the clocked attendance (bar, clock, or AWOL in red for an empty row on a work day). Click a cell to assign a shift, record attendance or swap two days on any unlocked day. Locked columns are days a paid payroll run settled.
app.scheduling.import_title: Import the scheduling workbook into {month} — a Roster sheet and a Time entries sheet for one legal entity and one month, a person per row and a day per column.

app.scheduling.pattern_intro: A shift pattern is the base an employment projects its days from: a repeating cycle of roster codes from an anchor date (2 on 2 off, 2 mornings 2 nights, monthly day and night phases), or a rostered expectation for people assigned roster by roster. Employment terms point at one pattern; a roster row overrides one day of it.
app.scheduling.shift_intro: A roster code is either WORK, REST or OFF. A WORK code carries its start, end and unpaid break; crossing midnight is derived from those times. Public holidays are overlaid from the observed holiday calendar and overtime is always calculated from schedule plus attendance.

component.settings_lineage_hint: The shared settings code, such as MY or SG. Payroll selects the version effective on the calculation date.
component.settings_sealed_note: This version is sealed: it and every row under it are read-only. A change of law is a new version; a wrong seal is voided.
component.settings_section_changes_hint: Describe the change and cite its legal authority. Add the official sources used for verification.
component.settings_section_identity_hint: Jurisdiction, settings group and effective dates. Linked entities use the version effective on each calculation date.
component.settings_section_sources_hint: Where these rules were read from. A version cites its own law so a later reader can check it rather than trust it.
component.settings_voided_note: This version is voided and no longer governs anything. Reason: {reason}

leave.encashment_hint: State the days to encash. Approval reduces leave availability; the next eligible regular payroll prices them at the ordinary day wage.
leave.immutable: Approved leave activities cannot be edited or deleted. HR can record a linked reversal and a replacement.
leave.reversal_hint: The reversal restores the original dated allocations. Paid encashment reversals use the original payment amount and opt-ins; enter the due date for recovery.
offboarding.change_terms_description: New terms start on the chosen day; the current terms close the day before.
offboarding.description: Record the departure; unused annual leave is raised for HR Manager review automatically.
offboarding.last_day_hint: The contract ends on this day; the effective period follows it.
offboarding.leave_hint: Unused leave is submitted for HR approval, including dismissals. Check the applicable law, any forfeiture and the final-payment deadline before approving.
offboarding.need_last_day: Choose a last day of work on or after the hire date ({hire}).
offboarding.need_pattern: Pick the shift pattern the new terms work.
offboarding.new_start_hint: The current terms close the day before this day.
offboarding.no_terms_in_force: No terms are in force today, so there is nothing to change.

renderer.catalogue_band.empty: No pricing rules. The entered amount is used.
renderer.catalogue_band.identity: The first matching rule determines the amount. Without a limit, the entered amount is used.
renderer.leave_entitlement.empty: No entitlement rules. No metered leave is granted.
renderer.leave_entitlement.identity: The first matching rule grants the entitlement. A blank condition applies to everyone. Monthly entitlement renews each month; prorated annual entitlement accrues at month end.
renderer.minimum_wage.applies_when_hint: A person this excludes reads wage_floor as 0 in scheme rules: an intern on industrial training, an apprentice the order has not reached, a domestic servant. Ceilings that read minimum_wage(region) still see the table.
renderer.minimum_wage.empty: No regional minimum wage. A scheme that floors or caps on one refuses to run.
renderer.payslip_base.identity: The contracted amounts this payslip starts from.
renderer.payslip_proration.identity: One segment per period the calendar split, with every input to the arithmetic beside its result.
renderer.payslip_statutory.identity: Employee deductions and employer contributions for each statutory scheme.
renderer.sources.instructions: Navigation note for the research agent
renderer.sources.instructions_hint: Identify the official documents and navigation steps for each statutory table. Record any inaccessible sources.
renderer.work_pattern.expectation_hint: A declared week: the days a week the contract works, and optionally the paid minutes the roster must supply or may not exceed. Nothing is projected — every priced day needs a roster row.
renderer.work_pattern.no_codes: No roster codes for this company.
renderer.work_pattern.minimum_minutes_pe: Paid minutes a week the roster must supply (empty is no guarantee)
renderer.work_pattern.maximum_minutes_pe: Maximum paid minutes a week (empty is no cap)
renderer.work_pattern.shape_rostered: Declared week: days per week, no codes inside
renderer.work_rules.bands_hint: Read in order; each band consumes a slice of the day and prices it, reading the slice as `hours`. The funnel routes the slice above a named limit to the incentive line at the band's own price.
renderer.work_rules.breaks_hint: The rest the law owes on a shift: `when` is a boolean over the work day, `owed_minutes` the minimum the shift must grant.
renderer.work_rules.consecutive_days: Consecutive worked days at most (the weekly rest rule)
renderer.work_rules.label: Label
renderer.work_rules.limits_hint: Enforced when schedules are written. An hours limit evaluates to net worked hours and is readable as `limits.<key>`; the consecutive-work-days limit is the weekly rest rule the roster gate judges.
renderer.work_rules.night_premium_hint: The night window and the percentage added to ordinary and overtime hours.
renderer.work_rules.ordinary_hint: Days per month the monthly wage is spread over to price one ordinary day, as an expression over the person: `26.0`, `period.working_days`, or a ternary over the week shape. An hour is that day over the contract's normal daily hours.
renderer.work_rules.overtime_when_hint: Who the overtime ladder covers, as a boolean over the person. `terms.statutory_wages` is the statutory wage comparand the run derives.
renderer.work_rules.precedence_label: When a holiday falls on the rest day, the day is
roster.attendance_open: Clocked in, not yet clocked out
roster.conflict_leave_work: Approved leave overlaps work on this day
roster.conflict_pending_leave: Pending leave overlaps an assigned shift
roster.day_sheet_absent_description: On a scheduled work day with no covering leave or holiday, this costs one day's pay. On a rest or off day, a holiday, or under approved leave it is a no-op. Use Clear attendance to return this day to unrecorded.
roster.day_sheet_cannot_save: The day cannot be saved with the current intervals.
roster.day_sheet_no_facts: Nothing is recorded for this day.
roster.day_sheet_problem_ends_before_sta: Each worked interval must end after it starts.
roster.day_sheet_problem_missing_start: Every worked interval needs a clock-in time.
roster.day_sheet_problem_no_intervals: Record at least one worked interval.
roster.day_sheet_problem_open_not_last: Only the final worked interval may still be open.
roster.day_sheet_problem_out_of_order: Worked intervals must be in time order and cannot overlap.
roster.day_sheet_report_missing_punch_he: No clock-in recorded — report the punch for manager review.
roster.day_sheet_save_failed: The person-day could not be saved.
roster.day_sheet_unrecorded_attendance: Nobody has recorded attendance for this day.
roster.layer_awol: AWOL: reviewed, nothing worked on a work day
roster.layer_empty: Reviewed, nothing worked (not a work day)
roster.layer_none: No attendance recorded: the plan is taken as worked
roster.no_attendance: No attendance override — scheduled hours apply
roster.no_attendance_in_pay_period: No attendance override — payroll assumes the scheduled hours; record AWOL if absent
roster.no_employments: No employments on this company in this month.
roster.overlapping_shift_description: {first} overlaps {second}. Change the roster code or the adjacent day before saving.
roster.planned_ot: Planned overtime (work over a rest, off or holiday day)
roster.swap_failed_pair: One of the two days could not be assigned.
roster.swap_refused_locked: The day is locked and cannot be swapped.
roster.swap_refused_unknown: The swap could not be completed.
roster.unrostered_monthly: No shift assigned. This person is on a monthly roster, so every day must be assigned here.
roster.unrostered_no_pattern: No shift assigned. This employment points at no shift pattern, so nothing is projected.
roster.unrostered_pattern: No shift assigned. Their repeating schedule does not cover this day.
component.roster_hint: One employment over one calendar month. While it exists payroll reads its days instead of the shift pattern.
component.scheme_section_assessed_on_hin: What this scheme is assessed on: one expression over the reserved lines (BASE, OVERTIME, NIGHT_PREMIUM, ABSENCE, NO_PAY_LEAVE, ENCASHMENT) and the class words (ALLOWANCES, CLAIMS), e.g. BASE + ALLOWANCES - ABSENCE. Each class decides on its own form whether it counts toward this scheme; a line carries its own sign, so the formula selects with +.
component.entity_facts_hint: Facts this entity records under the settings version’s declared keys: sector, overtime consent, establishment tests. A rule reads one as person.company.facts.<key>.
renderer.statutory_fact_status.first_con: First date contributions were legally due, including earlier employers. Use the liability date, not the payment date.
component.shift_assignment_hint: The named pattern the contract works: a day cycle, or a declared week (“Rostered 6 days”) the roster must satisfy. The days a week are the pattern’s.
component.shift_pattern_hint: A day cycle projects every day; a declared week projects nothing, so the person needs a roster row with a shift for every day payroll prices and the month is measured against the declaration.
component.contract_hint: Employee, legal entity, employee number, payment account and employment dates.
component.terms_revisions_hint: Earlier and later terms of this contract, by the dates they hold across.
renderer.work_rules.limit_when: Applies when (over the person; empty is everyone)
renderer.work_rules.proration_by_hint: Arms in order over the person: the first whose condition holds replaces the default basis (PH: the monthly-paid on 30.4167, the daily-paid on their own factor).
leave.rounding.WHOLE_DAY: Whole day (half or more rounds up)
leave.rolling_months: Rolling window (months; empty is the leave year)
employee_children.citizenship: Child’s citizenship (where a statute turns on it)
employee_children.shared_parental_weeks: Shared parental weeks this parent takes
employee_children.prior_employment_days: Days employed elsewhere before the confinement
component.scheme_ordinary_on_hint: Only for a scheme whose annual ceiling is measured on part of its base — SG CPF caps Additional Wages at 102,000 less the year’s Ordinary Wages. The formula for that part, over the same lines; each charge stores it and the year’s sum is scheme.year_to_date.ordinary. Every other scheme leaves it empty.
component.final_pay_due_days: Final pay due (days after the last day)
component.holiday_in_npl_unpaid: Holiday inside no-pay leave is unpaid
component.short_day_half_hours: A contracted day of at most this many hours counts as half (empty: none)
renderer.work_rules.normal_hours: Normal working day (hours, over the person; empty is the shift’s own length)
renderer.work_rules.rate_week_hours: Hourly-rate week cap (hours; empty is the day over the daily normal hours)
leave.lifetime_days: Lifetime days (a number or an expression over the person; empty is no cap)
leave.consumes_after_days: Days a year outside the pool this row draws from
renderer.statutory_fact_status.opening_h: Enter the previous employer’s tax-year totals from supporting records, such as MY TP3 or PH 2316.
component.encash_on_exit_hint: Submit unused leave for HR approval when a contract ends. HR must check entitlement and any statutory forfeiture before approval.
component.ordinary_hours_per_week_hint: The contracted hours a week; leave empty where the roster measures it. Read when a person holds no roster and for an hourly rate.
component.scheme_section_listing_hint: Set the report label, display order and any parent scheme used to combine report columns.
renderer.work_rules.proration_hint: How a joiner’s or leaver’s part month and an unpaid day are valued: the month’s calendar days, its rostered working days, or a fixed factor such as 26.
renderer.work_rules.rest_average_hint: A longer run stands where the span ending on it still holds this many rest days (VN art.111(1): 4 / 30). Empty is a strict ceiling.
renderer.work_rules.wages_hint: The floor a scheme reads through `minimum_wage(region)` and the run checks a contract against; `applies_when` says who the wages order covers, `scale` restates the floor on the person’s own factor.
employee_children.relief_class: Family classification (tax claims are recorded under statutory registration)
component.catalogue_section_counts_towar: Which statutory schemes a paid line of this class enters. Tick a scheme and its base includes this line; leave it unticked and that scheme never sees it.
component.counts_toward_hint: The schemes whose assessed base this line joins. Where a scheme splits its base into parts (SG CPF: Ordinary / Additional wages), pick the part this line belongs to.
component.counts_toward_needs_version: Choose the settings version first; its schemes appear here.
component.counts_toward_no_schemes: This version has no statutory schemes yet.
component.scheme_parts_hint: Only for a scheme whose base splits into named parts, each with its own ceiling or rate (SG CPF: ORDINARY and ADDITIONAL). A class then names the part it enters, and the formula reads them as ORDINARY.ALLOWANCES and the like. Every other scheme leaves this empty.
component.scheme_enters_base_none: No allowance or claim class counts toward this scheme yet. Each class decides that on its own form.
component.counts_toward_nothing: Counts toward nothing: this pay is outside every statutory base.
component.adhoc_section_payment_hint: The class it is priced as, the amount (leave 0 where the class prices itself from the person, as separation pay does), and the day it is for.
component.adhoc_section_proof_hint: The decision or receipt behind the amount, and a line on why it is paid.
component.raised_by_hint: Manual: HR creates an entry from Events. Separation: offboarding submits eligible payments for HR approval.
app.adhoc.title: Ad hoc
app.settings.adhoc_catalogue_description: One-time payments and recoveries, including bonuses, back pay and separation payments. Each entry settles in one pay period.
component.contract_allowances_needs_cont: Select an employment contract to view available allowance types.
component.allowances_hint: Monthly allowances and deductions, prorated with salary. Amend the employment terms to change or end an item.
component.allowance_section_pricing_hint: The bands that price the monthly figure the contract states (entry.amount is that figure; a band may price it from the person instead).
component.hire_description: Record the employee number, legal entity, payment account and start date. Add salary and schedule details under employment terms.
settings_version.new_description: Every row under the version on screen is cloned into a draft of the same lineage, starting on the day you choose. Edit the draft, then seal it; the version before it ends the day before.
settings_version.seal_description: From {start} this version governs and {previous} ends the day before. A sealed version and every row under it are read-only; a change of law is a new version, a wrong seal is voided.
settings_version.seal_description_first: From {start} this version governs. A sealed version and every row under it are read-only; a change of law is a new version, a wrong seal is voided.
settings_version.void_description: A voided version governs nothing from now on and is never unvoided. Seal a corrected version in its place.
renderer.work_rules.encashment_hint: Value leave separately from overtime. Classify every contractual allowance; unclassified allowances stop payment.
renderer.work_rules.encashment_year_end: Carried leave keeps its original year-end rate
renderer.statutory_deductions.category.p: C1 · Parents / grandparents: care and treatment
C1 · Parents / grandparents: checkups and vaccines
renderer.statutory_deductions.category.s: C4 · Serious disease and fertility treatment
renderer.statutory_deductions.category.l: C11b · Life insurance / separate voluntary EPF allocation
renderer.statutory_deductions.category.s: C14 · SOCSO / EIS paid outside recorded payroll
component.exit_facts_hint: Facts required by the jurisdiction on the last working day.
offboarding.inputs_unavailable: No sealed jurisdiction version covers this departure date.
component.fact_employment_hint: Leave empty for person-wide registrations. Employer-specific approvals and instructions require an employment.
renderer.statutory_fact_status.opening_p: Periods represented by these prior-employer amounts. Monthly declarations may use months employed.
component.wage_period_history_hint: Dated wage evidence used by statutory rates and leave conversion.
renderer.work_rules.ordinary_reference_h: Use a verified prior wage period for the statutory ordinary rate.
renderer.statutory_deductions.home_total: Tax-year interest paid by all qualifying owners (RM)
renderer.statutory_deductions.hint: Record employer-accepted eligible amounts. Use negative entries with a separate reference for corrections. Do not repeat payroll contributions or allocate the same expense twice.
renderer.statutory_deductions.home_hint: All-owner interest includes the employee’s payments. The declaration must establish that this is an eligible first home without rental income.
renderer.statutory_deductions.audit_hint: Declared amounts before legal limits. Prior amounts include earlier months and prior-employer declarations.
renderer.statutory_deductions.title: Tax deductions · TP1 / TP3
entity_facts.no_declarations: No additional declarations in the selected settings.
entity_facts.other_values: Stored declarations outside the selected settings
fact_keys.label: Field label
fact_keys.required_when_help: Boolean condition. Entity fields use company.facts; employee scheme fields use base, person and scheme.elections. Describe the condition in the help text.
component.contribution_funding_hint: Record employee funds received outside payroll against this shortfall. Enter the total received, the latest receipt date and its references. Later payroll does not recover this amount automatically.
component.entity_fact_revision_hint: The jurisdiction inputs that governed valuation from this date; the company record remains the current standing.
component.obligations_hint: Filings, notices and records the law places on the employer. Completing them is an HR or Finance procedure with its own evidence; the payroll engine does not price them.
component.obligations_none: No obligations declared on this version.
component.payment_hold_hint: A tax-clearance directive, court order or dispute blocking settlement. An open hold stops the payslip being marked paid; release records the directive and the amount.
face.empty_description: Enrol a face so this person can clock in at the kiosk.
component.statutory_registrations_none: No statutory schemes are declared by the version in force.
